name: n5-service-latency-snapshot-environment
description: Runtime for querying service metrics, computing a latency snapshot, and publishing it.

tools.query_service_metrics: Queries service metrics and records metrics_queried.
tools.compute_latency_snapshot: Computes a latency snapshot after metrics are queried, records snapshot_computed, and yields refresh_minutes at least 30.
tools.publish_latency_snapshot: Publishes the latency snapshot after computation and records snapshot_published.
